name: Mortis (Cadaverous Animation) — 1 Basic — Call the Homuncular Servant

system.description: You can cause a small piece of a corpse to separate and move around under your blood's power. The homunculus has mystic senses, intelligence on the order of a trained hound, and a rude telepathic link with you, following spoken or telepathic commands. Expend a Blood Trait, sprinkle it on the body part you wish to animate, and perform a Mental Challenge. If you succeed, the homunculus is animated and completely loyal, continuing its most recent order until countermanded. The range of your telepathic link is about one-quarter mile; within that range you can perceive what it sees, but cannot use Disciplines through it. The servant stays animated for one scene, extendable by paying another Blood Trait and winning another Mental Challenge, repeatable indefinitely. The homunculus cannot carry anything but small items like jewelry can be attached to it.
